missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Объект' is the masculine nominative subject. 'Этот' and 'важный' agree in masculine gender, describing the facility.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Объект' is the accusative direct object of 'построил'; inanimate masculine accusative equals nominative. 'Новый' agrees with it.
Strategic focus: Dative with preposition. 'Объекту' is dative after 'к', marking the place toward which access is denied. 'Охрана' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Объекта' is genitive after 'возле', marking proximity. 'Охрана' is the nominative subject of 'стоит'.
Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'Объекте' is prepositional after 'на', showing where the engineers work. 'Инженеры' is the nominative plural subject.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after preposition. 'Объектом' is instrumental after 'за', the usual way to say observing something. 'Учёные' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after quantity. 'Объектов' is genitive plural after 'много'. 'Промышленных' agrees, and 'в районе' is the prepositional location.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural object. 'Объекты' is the accusative plural object of 'охраняет'; inanimate plural accusative equals nominative. 'Важные' agrees in the plural.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Объекта' is genitive, showing whose safety is meant. 'Безопасность' is the nominative subject of the clause.
Strategic focus: Instrumental plural after preposition. 'Объектами' is instrumental plural after 'между', placing the road between them. 'Дорога' is the subject.
